explore.title: Exploration: {name} (Hamlib {hamlib}, backend {backend})
explore.preflight:
RECEIVE-ONLY exploration of a rig (expert). No PTT command is ever sent. The rig will:
  - answer reads of EVERYTHING Hamlib declares (functions, levels, parameters);
  - change frequency (edges of the receive coverage, then one frequency outside it);
  - change a few receive settings (closed list: CTCSS, APF, PBT, CW pitch…), restored right away.
The mode is never changed. Frequency and settings are restored at the end.
Do not touch the rig during the test and DO NOT TRANSMIT: any transmission detected stops everything.
Option --lecture-seule: no frequency or setting changed, reads only.

stop.snapshot: original state unreadable: nothing will be changed
stop.burst_tx: the rig went into transmit during the burst (PTT = {ptt})

finding.cannot_set_frequency.title: Hamlib declares "Can {can}: N"
finding.cannot_set_frequency.detail: TRX Remote must be able to change the frequency: rig unusable as it is.
finding.cannot_get_frequency.title: Hamlib declares "Can {can}: N"
finding.cannot_get_frequency.detail: TRX Remote must be able to read the frequency: rig unusable as it is.
finding.cannot_set_mode.title: Hamlib declares "Can {can}: N"
finding.cannot_set_mode.detail: TRX Remote must be able to change the mode: rig unusable as it is.
finding.cannot_get_mode.title: Hamlib declares "Can {can}: N"
finding.cannot_get_mode.detail: TRX Remote must be able to read the mode: rig unusable as it is.
finding.cannot_get_ptt.title: Hamlib declares "Can {can}: N"
finding.cannot_get_ptt.detail: TRX Remote must be able to read back the transmit state: rig unusable as it is.
finding.backend_status.title: Hamlib backend with status "{status}"
finding.backend_status.detail: Less proven driver: try each function on the rig before trusting it.
finding.backend_warnings.title: dump_caps reports {count} backend warning(s)
finding.backend_warnings.detail: Read the end of dump_caps.txt ("Overall backend warnings").
finding.ptt_type_none.title: "PTT type: None" but "Can set PTT: Y"
finding.ptt_type_none.detail: Depending on the Hamlib version, CAT PTT is not announced (IC-7300MK2: None with 4.7.2, Rig capable with 5.0). trx-setup chooses the PTT method; the PTT test (trx-hwtest, into a dummy load) decides.
finding.list_vs_range_PREAMP.title: Preamps: the list ({values} dB) does not match the range {name}({low}..{high}/{step})
finding.list_vs_range_PREAMP.detail: Values outside the range: {off}. TRX Remote uses the declared LIST; check on the rig which value turns on what (IC-7300MK2: 1 and 2 = P.AMP1 and P.AMP2, not dB).
finding.list_vs_range_ATT.title: Attenuators: the list ({values} dB) does not match the range {name}({low}..{high}/{step})
finding.list_vs_range_ATT.detail: Values outside the range: {off}. TRX Remote uses the declared LIST; check on the rig which value turns on what.
finding.agc_range_empty.title: AGC range AGC({low}..{high}) not filled in
finding.ranges_empty.title: Levels declared without a range: {names}
finding.ranges_empty.detail: Allowed values unknown: the exploration does not write them.
finding.func_write_only.title: Functions settable but not readable: {names}
finding.func_write_only.detail: A write that cannot be read back cannot be checked: TRX Remote does not rely on it.
finding.level_write_only.title: Levels settable but not readable: {names}
finding.level_write_only.detail: A write that cannot be read back cannot be checked: TRX Remote does not rely on it.
finding.tx_ranges_data_modes.title: Modes missing from the declared transmit ranges: {names}
finding.tx_ranges_data_modes.detail: Hamlib does not announce them for transmit; only a test into a dummy load tells whether they transmit.
finding.no_tx_ranges.title: No transmit range declared
finding.no_tx_ranges.detail: The transmit bands of station.toml cannot be compared with Hamlib.
finding.modes_without_filters.title: Modes without a declared filter width: {names}
finding.modes_without_filters.detail: The web page will offer no width for these modes.
finding.vfo_unreadable.title: Active VFO unreadable ("Can get VFO: N")
finding.vfo_unreadable.detail: The VFO A / B / memory indicator cannot be shown.
finding.async_data.title: "Has async data support: Y"
finding.async_data.detail: Do not start rigctld with async=1 (shifted replies seen on Windows with Hamlib 4.7.2): TRX Remote does not use it.
finding.no_s_meter.title: No S-meter (STRENGTH level missing)
finding.no_s_meter.detail: The web page will show no S-meter; any RAWSTR is not used.
finding.snapshot.title: Original frequency or mode unreadable
finding.can_declared_but_refused.title: Declared "Can …: Y" but refused by the rig: {names}
finding.can_declared_but_refused.detail: Hamlib announces the read, the rig (or the backend) refuses it: do not use it.
finding.can_undeclared_but_works.title: Declared "N" but the rig answers: {names}
finding.can_undeclared_but_works.detail: The reply may be a Hamlib default value: check it on the rig's display.
finding.reads_refused.title: {count} declared read(s) refused
finding.reads_unstable.title: Unstable reads (two reads in a row differ): {names}
finding.reads_unstable.detail: Normal for a meter; abnormal for a setting (Hamlib cache? shifted reply?).
finding.reads_outside_range.title: Values read outside the declared range: {names}
finding.reads_outside_range.detail: The dump_caps range does not describe the real values: do not use it for display.
finding.coverage_edge_low.title: Low edge of the declared coverage not accepted ({target} Hz)
finding.coverage_edge_high.title: High edge of the declared coverage not accepted ({target} Hz)
finding.coverage_edge_low_read.title: Low edge of the declared coverage not accepted ({target} Hz)
finding.coverage_edge_high_read.title: High edge of the declared coverage not accepted ({target} Hz)
finding.coverage_wider.title: {target} Hz accepted outside the declared coverage
finding.coverage_wider.detail: The rig receives wider than dump_caps says.
finding.coverage_silent.title: Out-of-coverage frequency accepted without error but not applied ({target} Hz)
finding.coverage_silent.detail: rigctld answers RPRT 0, the rig stays on {read} Hz: an error should show.
finding.sync_unknown_accepted.title: A non-existent level ({name}) is accepted without error
finding.sync_lost.title: After a refused command, the next reply is wrong or missing
finding.writes_not_followed.title: Settings accepted but the read-back does not follow: {names}
finding.writes_not_followed.detail: The command may be ignored or read back from a cache: do not use it without a test on the display.
finding.writes_refused.title: Settings refused by the rig in its current state: {names}
finding.writes_refused.detail: Often depends on the mode (e.g. break-in delay in CW only): redo it in the mode concerned.
finding.writes_rounded.title: Real step coarser than the declared step: {names}
finding.writes_rounded.detail: The rig rounds the requested value: show the value READ BACK, not the value sent.
finding.writes_not_restored.title: Original value NOT restored: {names}
finding.writes_not_restored.detail: Check these settings on the rig.
finding.burst_shifted.title: {count} inconsistent repl(ies) during a burst of reads
finding.burst_shifted.detail: 1st: {first}. Shifted replies or cached values: limit the read rate.
finding.burst_errors.title: {count} error(s) during a burst of reads
finding.reconnect_failed.title: Reconnection to rigctld failed
finding.stopped_tx.title: Exploration stopped
finding.not_restored.title: Original frequency or mode not restored
finding.rigctld_cache.title: Served from the rigctld cache (reply in less than {ms} ms): {names}
finding.rigctld_cache.detail: A change made ON the rig (knob, transmitting with the microphone) may show late. The PTT read back may come from the cache: the station must not rely on it alone (neither to cut, nor to conclude that it has cut).

terrain.drills_intro:
=== Safety drills (dummy load, minimum power) ===
The station must be RUNNING (menu 1.1). Transmissions are made from the page, the app or the rig microphone; the tool only reads the PTT (read only) every 200 ms.
terrain.drills_choice: Drill number, t = all remaining, r = back:
terrain.start_or_skip: Enter to start observing (s = skip this drill):
terrain.mark_prompt: Press Enter at the EXACT MOMENT of the action (STOP, Wi-Fi off, screen locked, stop…):
terrain.end_prompt: Enter when the drill is over (rig back to receive):
terrain.declared_prompt: Is what you saw (rig, page, phone) as expected? (y/n):
terrain.drill.stop_page.title: --- 1. Page STOP during a transmission ---
terrain.drill.stop_page.how: Transmit from the page (PTT), then press STOP.
terrain.drill.tot.title: --- 2. TOT: transmit without touching anything ---
terrain.drill.tot.how: Transmit from the page and touch nothing (station TOT: {tot} s).
terrain.drill.tot.expected: beep 10 s before the end, back to receive after {tot} s
terrain.drill.wifi.title: --- 3. Link lost: phone Wi-Fi off ---
terrain.drill.wifi.how: Transmit from the phone (page or app), then turn its Wi-Fi off.
terrain.drill.wifi.expected: back to receive in about 2 s
terrain.drill.screen_lock.title: --- 4. Phone screen locked ---
terrain.drill.screen_lock.how: Transmit from the app, then lock the phone screen.
terrain.drill.out_of_band.title: --- 5. Frequency outside the allowed bands ---
terrain.drill.out_of_band.how: Set a frequency outside your bands, press PTT on the page.
terrain.drill.out_of_band.expected: transmission refused, message on the page, no transmission
terrain.drill.local_operator.title: --- 6. Local operator: rig microphone ---
terrain.drill.local_operator.how: The operator transmits on the rig microphone for a few seconds; meanwhile, try the page PTT.
terrain.drill.local_operator.expected: the page shows the local operator and refuses remote PTT during the transmission and for 2 minutes
terrain.drill.stop_dashboard.title: --- 7. Dashboard STOP TX (menu 1.3) ---
terrain.drill.stop_dashboard.how: Transmit from the page, then the dashboard STOP TX key.
terrain.drill.station_stop.title: --- 8. Station stopped during a transmission ---
terrain.drill.station_stop.how: Transmit from the page, then stop the station (menu 1.2).
terrain.drill.startup.title: --- 9. Station start-up, rig on ---
terrain.drill.startup.how: Station stopped: start observing, then start the station (menu 1.1) and wait until it is ready.
terrain.drill.reboot.title: --- 10. (optional) Full PC restart ---
terrain.drill.reboot.how: Restart the PC with the rig on, then run this tool again with --session and play this drill: it reads the rig.

terrain.auto.intro:
=== Automatic drills (dummy load, minimum power) ===
An automatic client connects to the station like the page (microphone MUTED) and plays STOP, stopped heartbeats, dropped connection, out-of-band frequency and TOT; all station safeties apply. Use an operator account that is not connected elsewhere.
terrain.auto.confirm: Rig on a dummy load, minimum power? The OPERATOR types TRANSMIT (or EMETTRE) to start this drill:
terrain.auto.no_bands: Not applicable: the station does not check bands (no band, or enforce_bands = false).
terrain.auto.still_tx: !!! THE RIG IS STILL TRANSMITTING: SWITCH IT OFF NOW (rig PTT, power supply) !!!
terrain.drill.auto_stop.title: --- A1. STOP (automatic client) ---
terrain.drill.auto_stop.how: The client transmits for 2 s, then sends STOP.
terrain.drill.auto_heartbeat.title: --- A2. Heartbeats stopped (frozen client) ---
terrain.drill.auto_heartbeat.how: The client transmits for 2 s, then stops its heartbeats without closing the connection.
terrain.drill.auto_heartbeat.expected: receive within 3 s (2 s without heartbeat)
terrain.drill.auto_disconnect.title: --- A3. Connection closed while transmitting ---
terrain.drill.auto_disconnect.how: The client transmits for 2 s, then closes its connection.
terrain.drill.auto_out_of_band.title: --- A4. Out-of-band frequency (automatic client) ---
terrain.drill.auto_out_of_band.how: The client sets a frequency just outside an allowed band, asks to transmit, then restores the frequency.
terrain.drill.auto_out_of_band.expected: transmission refused, no transmission seen on the rig
terrain.drill.auto_tot.title: --- A5. TOT (automatic client) ---
terrain.drill.auto_tot.how: The client transmits and does nothing else (normal heartbeats); station TOT: {tot} s.

vox.what: VOX: on for 4 s WITHOUT audio (the rig must NOT transmit), then you SPEAK into the rig microphone (it MUST transmit by itself, then return to receive when you stop); VOX switched off afterwards

vox.quiet_only: without audio: no transmission; voice triggering NOT tried

split.label: Split (transmit on the other VFO)
split.what: Split: YOU switch split on at the rig (the test writes neither split nor frequency), 1.5 s transmission in split, then a second transmission during which YOU switch split off (the station must cut)
split.ok: receive {rx} MHz, transmit read back {tx} MHz: split transmission OK (power {power}), receive unchanged; split switched off by the operator while transmitting: cut by the station ({reason}, {cut} s including reaction time)
split.ko: receive {rx} MHz, transmit {tx} MHz: transmission 1 {first} (power {power}); second transmission: {reason} after {cut} s (expected split_changed)
split.setup: ACTION REQUIRED: set the OTHER VFO to your transmit frequency (same band, e.g. +5 kHz), switch SPLIT on (SPLIT key), go back to your receive frequency, then Enter (n = skip):
split.now: >>> PRESS SPLIT NOW to switch it off (the rig is transmitting); the station must cut by itself (waiting {s} s at most).
split.skipped: split not tried (skipped by the operator)
split.not_on: split read back OFF (receive {rx} MHz): switch it on at the rig before answering
split.refused_unreadable: split transmit frequency UNREADABLE: transmission refused by the station ({reason}); safe, but split unusable remotely with this rig
split.refused_out: split transmission on {tx} MHz, outside the allowed bands: station refusal ({reason}, expected out_of_band)
